turns.user: Plan a 2-day Taipei trip from Hong Kong for 1 person starting 4 December 2026, budget 12,000 TWD.
turns.reply:
A compact two-day Taipei trip built around culture, landmarks and Taiwanese food. You arrive on the 16:45 flight and have a relaxed first evening: a floodlit walk at Liberty Square, then a calm Taiwanese dinner. Day two covers the National Palace Museum's Chinese art collection, a classic Taiwanese lunch, and the Taipei 101 Observatory for city views. An early dinner at Din Tai Fung leaves a comfortable buffer before the 21:15 flight home.

Day 1 (2026-12-04): Liberty Square Archway, Mountain & Sea House Restaurant.

Day 2 (2026-12-05): National Palace Museum, 明福台菜, Taipei 101 Observatory, Din Tai Fung 101.

Stay: CU Hotel Taipei.

Estimated total: 4890 TWD of 12000.

Not confirmed by a source: No hotel nightly rates, restaurant prices or Taipei 101 Observatory ticket price were available, so the total cost can't be confirmed.; Opening hours were only listed for Monday to Wednesday. Friday and Saturday hours are assumed to be similar..
